usage: A common noun for a type of business or sector, like food, finance, education, or construction.
Often used with words like 發展, 踏入, and 轉行業 to talk about career paths or market changes.
Can sound a bit formal in speech; in casual talk, people may also say 做邊行 or 行頭 to mean a field of work.
Use it when you mean the bigger industry as a category, not one single company or job title.
